ann.t: Press Release — Sanathan Textiles Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 04, 2026, titled "Press Release   Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Sanathan Textiles Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

Press Release — Sanathan Textiles Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 03, 2026, titled "Press Release - Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended June 30, 2026".

Appointment — Sanathan Textiles Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of M/s Walker Chandiok  and Co LLP as Statutory Auditors of the Company for a consecutive second term of 5 years

Outcome of Board Meeting — Sanathan Textiles Limited has informed the Exchange regarding re-appointment of  M/s Walker Chandiok & Co., LLP as the Statutory Auditor of the Company for a second consecutive term of 5 years  and  re-appointment of M/s. Mahajan & Aibara Chartered Accountants LLP, as an I
Outcome of Board Meeting — Sanathan Textiles Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.

Press Release — Sanathan Textiles Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated May 15, 2026, titled "Press Release on Audited Financial Results for the Quarter and Financial Year ended March 31, 2026 ".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Sanathan Textiles Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.

General Updates — Sanathan Textiles Limited has informed the Exchange that Sanathan Polycot Private Limited a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, has entered into a Share Subscription and Shareholders  Agreement ( SSSHA ) and a Power Supply and Consumption Agreement ( PSCA ) to acquire 26% stake
Outcome of Board Meeting — Sanathan Textiles Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.

Copy of Newspaper Publication — Sanathan Textiles Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for the extract of Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2025
